name: process-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the engineering-process category in one install — git workflow, approach deliberation (with the build-vs-buy, estimation, rollout, and pattern-selection disciplines folded into approaches), hindsight mining, docs upkeep, subagent orchestration, task execution, stack scanning, plugin scouting, a token-cost warn hook (lean), and file-aware skill auto-routing (skill-router). Uninstall cleanly with /process-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
